limits: This review authorizes only the bound source selection and geometry for a closest faithful2D adaptation. Exact retail UV motif placement, invisible surfaces, absolute body metrics and full original animation cycles are not certified.
Two-keypose walks are separate front/back-three-quarter drawings with opposite leading legs. No bitmap flip, downsample or recolour creates the opposite direction.
Real game admission, menus, projectile origins, pause and fallback behavior remain to be tested before installation.
